finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0.

The real problem was two spots the bundler bump broke, hiding among all the deprecation noise:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That was `undefined`, so calling `.toFixed(0)` on it crashed the build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now treats `undefined` the same as `false`.

Everything else — the `DEP0142`/`DEP0198`/etc. lines — is just deprecation noise from the bump, not something breaking the build. It finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
